plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the early 1950s an FBI field agent in Washington named Guy Hottel was investigating Edward Condon, a physicist, and building a file on him. The story as told includes Condon losing his Q clearance, a high US security clearance for nuclear secrets, though one of Michels's tellings only speaks of the file. It matters because Condon later had a role in studying these sightings, so his standing with the government would color that work.
